cues: Here is the honest summary. Baseline features carry a weak signal, and recipient age is the association that survives a multivariable Cox model.
The five clusters are a readable map of who is in this cohort. They are not a survival classifier. The log-rank p-value is zero point two five, and D B scan never finds them.

The limits are the size and the design. One hundred eighty-seven patients and eighty-five deaths cannot support a rich model, and a cross-validated C index of zero point five six is only a little above a coin flip. The clusters were chosen on the full sample and then tested on that same sample.

Missingness itself is tied to survival. The baseline-missing log-rank p-value is zero point zero zero six, which is a warning about the data. This is one public cohort, analyzed once, with every predictor frozen on the day of transplant.
